meta.title: Leo's Bus List and TV List
meta.textType: a bus list and a TV list with times in words

paragraphs: I am Leo, and I am ten years old. On Saturday, my mom and I go to town by bus. Mom writes a bus list for us on the fridge. Dad stays at home to cook. The first bus leaves the station at ten to nine. The next bus leaves at a quarter past nine. The last bus home leaves town at half past four. We take the bus at a quarter past nine. The ride takes forty-five minutes.

The bus ticket is cheap, only ten baht. I collect old bus tickets in a small box. "Why do you collect them?" asks Mom. "They are funny," I say. "I like the little numbers." I find a seat next to the window. The bus is full, and Mom stands for five minutes. I look out of the window at the shops.

At half past four, we are on the bus home. Mom has fruit in a bag for dinner. Now I look at the TV list on Mom's phone. My favorite cartoon is at a quarter to five. But the bus gets home at a quarter past five. "Oh no! Poor me!" I say. "What's the matter?" asks Mom. "I can't see my cartoon!"

Mom looks at the list again and smiles. "The cartoon is on again at a quarter past seven," she says. "And a film about pyramids is at half past six." "Can we watch the film first?" I ask. "Yes, we can," says Mom. I am happy again. The day in town is fun, and the evening is fun too. I put my new ticket in the box.
